start.speaker: sera
start.text: Door closes. Good. I wanted to say this somewhere the Envoys cannot hear it. The village I purged. I have started to think it was not the last one they will ask for, if we go their way. I would like you to know I will refuse, next time. Whatever it costs.

choices.text: It will not come to that while I run the Beacon.
You do not have to refuse alone. Say the word and the party walks.

promise.speaker: sera
promise.text: Then I am holding you to it. Sleep well.

together.speaker: sera
together.text: That is the first time anyone has said that to me and meant it. Sleep well.
